articles.headline: How Iowa ended up with Van Hayden, college football's most unique cover band
articles.description: A group of Hawkeyes fans decided to learn Van Halen covers as a bit. Now they're the life of the party on game days.

images.name: Van Hayden - LEDE [1296x729]
images.caption: Monday through Friday, they fill prescriptions, write code, consult on health plans and restore historic homes. On Saturdays in Iowa City, they put on white pants, aviators and fake mustaches, climb into a retired ambulance and become Van Hayden.

images.name: 01 - Van Hayden Inline [2000x4043]
images.caption: Legendary Iowa coach Hayden Fry wanted the Hawkeyes to look good, and rock gods Van Halen packed arenas. The spirit of both '80s icons combine at Van Hayden's tailgate concerts.
images.credit: AP Photo/Reed Saxon, Mary Beth Koeth for ESPN, Fin Costello/Redferns

images.name: 02 - Van Hayden Inline [8031x5357]
images.caption: Andy Olson (Eddie Van Hayden), Jake Olson (Alex Van Hayden), 15-year-old Masen Funk (The Pasadena Kid) and Brent Buresh (Michael Van Hayden) lay down the grooves while Robby Marvin, front, gets the crowd going as Hayden Lee Roth.

article.story: MURFREESBORO, Tenn. -- — Antonio Martin Jr. ran for 104 yards and a touchdown, Roman Gagliano threw for 173 yards and two scores, and Middle Tennessee took down Nevada 27-20 on Saturday. The Blue Raiders (2-1) didn't take a lead until the second half, scored twice in less than four minutes in the fourth quarter, and held on for the win. Turnovers doomed the Wolfpack (1-2), with two fumbles and an interception in the second half that allowed MTSU to rally. Dominic Bourgeois kicked a 23-yard field goal that tied the score at 20-all with 9:51 to go, and Martin Jr. ran it in from 3 yards out to put the Raiders up for good. Koraun Perdue hauled in his only reception for a 23-yard touchdown score, and Cam'Ron Lacy had six grabs for 32 yards and a touchdown for the Blue Raiders. On defense, Ashton Taylor and Korey Smith each had 10 tackles. Jason Hardy had an interception and Jackson Lowe had a sack. For the Wolfpack, Carter Jones was 15-for-25 passing for 185 yards. Dominic Kelley and Carter Jones each had rushing touchdowns. Up next Nevada: hosts Air Force next Saturday. Middle Tennessee: at Jacksonville State next Saturday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college football coverage here
